title: The wrong door
starting_code:
if left_door.locked:
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_left(3)
    left_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_right(9)
else:
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(3)
    right_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_right(3)
hints: My program always tries to open the locked door! It does just the opposite.
Look at the `if` and `else` parts. The lines under `if` should go under `else`!
Swap the lines under `if` with the ones under `else`.
intro: Oh no! I wrote a program for when we come back through this room, and it goes straight to the locked door! I think I put the `if` lines where the `else` ones went... Can you fix it?
outro: Thank you! Now we can come back this way any night. Look, further on there is a corridor with three doors in a row.
learned: Now you know how to read a condition and see which lines run.
changes: The door that is locked is not always the same one.
changed: This time, the locked door is the other one.
